kebab_example: aliyun yike submit-yike-storyboard-job --source-type Novel --file-url http://test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test.txt --shot-split-mode firstPersonNarration --style-id RealisticPhotography --aspect-ratio 4:3 --resolution 720P --shot-prompt-mode multi --narration-voice-id sys_YoungGracefulWoman --video-model wan2.6-r2v-flash --model-params AudioEnable_:_false --title test-title --user-data NotifyAddress_:_https://www.callback.com --skip-failure-shot true --exec-mode FullPipeline --keep-origin-dialogue true --shot-prompt-lang example-string --need-caption true --api-version 2026-03-19 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitYikeStoryboardJob

parameters.help_en: The task title. If not specified, a default title is automatically generated based on the date. The title cannot exceed 128 bytes in length and must be UTF-8 encoded
parameters.help_zh: 任务标题。若不提供，根据日期自动生成默认title  长度不超过128字节  UTF8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The custom settings in JSON format. Fields include:
NotifyAddress: the callback URL for task completion. MNS callbacks and HTTP callbacks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
自定义设置，Json 格式。其中：
NotifyAddress 为任务完成的回调，支持设置MNS回调以及Http回调
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip failed shots. Default value: True
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过失败分镜，默认为True
parameters.name: skip_failure_shot

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode for storyboard generation. Valid values:
FullPipeline: full pipeline generation, which includes storyboard generation and shot video generation.
StoryboardOnly: generates only the storyboard
parameters.help_zh:
故事板生成执行模式。取值为：
FullPipeline：全链路生成（包含故事板生成以及分镜视频生成）。
StoryboardOnly：仅生成故事板
parameters.name: exec_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retain the original dialogue during final video composition. Default value: True
parameters.help_zh: 成片合成时是否保留原对白，默认为True
parameters.name: keep_origin_dialogue
